era.church.intro: From a room in Jerusalem the message crosses seas and borders. Peter, Paul and many others carry it to Antioch, Asia Minor, Greece and Rome, and John closes the story on the island of Patmos.
era.church.name: The Early Church
era.conquest.intro: Across the Jordan the land has to be taken and then lived in. Joshua's campaigns give way to the Judges: cycles of failure, rescue and rescue again, until the people ask for a king.
era.conquest.name: Conquest & Judges
era.divided.intro: The kingdom splits in two. Prophets such as Elijah, Isaiah and Jeremiah speak into a long decline, as Assyria and then Babylon grow stronger, until both kingdoms fall.
era.divided.name: Divided Kingdom
era.egypt.intro: Joseph's family goes down to Egypt in famine and stays for centuries. Then a deliverer arrives, a sea divides, and a nation walks through the wilderness to a mountain where it receives its law.
era.egypt.name: Egypt & Exodus
era.exile.intro: Jerusalem burns and its people are carried to Babylon. Then Persia changes the map, and groups of exiles return to rebuild the city, the temple and the wall.
era.exile.name: Exile & Return
era.gospels.intro: In a small province of the Roman Empire a child is born in Bethlehem. Around the Sea of Galilee, and then on a last road to Jerusalem, a ministry unfolds that the rest of the Bible looks back on.
era.gospels.name: Life of Jesus
era.kingdom.intro: Saul, David and Solomon: three kings in about a century. Jerusalem becomes a capital, a temple rises on Mount Moriah, and the kingdom reaches its greatest extent.
era.kingdom.name: United Kingdom
era.patriarchs.intro: A man leaves Mesopotamia for a land he has never seen, and a family begins to grow into a people. Abraham, Isaac and Jacob wander between Haran, Canaan and Egypt, and the story acquires its first real places.
era.patriarchs.name: Patriarchs
era.primeval.intro: Before there were nations there was a garden. Creation, a fall, a flood, and a tower: the first chapters of the story are told in a world with almost no map, only genealogies stretching across two thousand years.
era.primeval.name: Primeval history
era.silence.intro: Between the last prophet and the first gospel there are some four hundred years that the narrative does not tell. Empires change, and the world is being prepared for what comes next.
era.silence.name: Between the Testaments

home.card.cosmos.title: Cosmos

home.card.journeys.title: Journeys
home.card.lifespans.text: Pick any year and see who was alive, who they overlapped with.

home.lead: Four thousand years, three thousand people, one thousand places. Walk the routes, follow the families, watch the story move across the map.
home.title: The Bible, alive
journey.abraham.intro: A man of Mesopotamia hears a voice and walks west with his family and flocks. This is where the story of a chosen people begins.
journey.abraham.stop.0.name: Ur
journey.abraham.stop.0.note: Terah takes Abram, Sarai and Lot out of Ur of the Chaldeans, heading for Canaan.
journey.abraham.stop.1.name: Haran
journey.abraham.stop.1.note: They settle at Haran until Terah dies. Then the call comes: go from your country to the land I will show you.
journey.abraham.stop.2.name: Shechem
journey.abraham.stop.2.note: In the land of Canaan, at the oak of Moreh, the promise is given: to your offspring I will give this land.
journey.abraham.stop.3.name: Bethel
journey.abraham.stop.3.note: Abram pitches his tent between Bethel and Ai, and builds an altar.
journey.abraham.stop.4.name: Memphis
journey.abraham.stop.4.note: Famine drives him south into Egypt.
journey.abraham.stop.5.name: Hebron
journey.abraham.stop.5.note: Back in Canaan he settles by the oaks of Mamre at Hebron.
journey.abraham.stop.6.name: Gerar
journey.abraham.stop.6.note: He journeys toward the Negeb and lives for a time at Gerar.
journey.abraham.stop.7.name: Beersheba
journey.abraham.stop.7.note: Abraham plants a tamarisk tree at Beersheba and calls on the name of the LORD.
journey.abraham.stop.8.name: Jerusalem
journey.abraham.stop.8.note: The test on Mount Moriah: the land where, a thousand years later, a temple would stand.
journey.abraham.sub: From Ur of the Chaldeans to the land of promise
journey.abraham.title: Abraham's Calling
journey.conquest.intro: The river parts, the walls fall, and a nomadic people becomes a nation in a land.
journey.conquest.stop.0.name: Shittim
journey.conquest.stop.0.note: Joshua rises early and sets out from Shittim to the Jordan.
journey.conquest.stop.1.name: Gilgal
journey.conquest.stop.1.note: The people come up out of the Jordan and camp at Gilgal.
journey.conquest.stop.2.name: Jericho
journey.conquest.stop.2.note: The people shout, the wall falls down flat.
journey.conquest.stop.3.name: Ai
journey.conquest.stop.3.note: After a first defeat, Ai falls to an ambush.
journey.conquest.stop.4.name: Gibeon
journey.conquest.stop.4.note: The Gibeonites ally with Israel; the sun stands still over Gibeon.
journey.conquest.stop.5.name: Hazor
journey.conquest.stop.5.note: In the north Joshua defeats the coalition and burns Hazor.
journey.conquest.sub: Across the Jordan and into Canaan
journey.conquest.title: Joshua's Campaign
journey.david.intro: A boy with a sling, a fugitive in caves, a king in a conquered city.
journey.david.stop.0.name: Bethlehem
journey.david.stop.0.note: Samuel anoints the youngest son of Jesse in the midst of his brothers.
journey.david.stop.1.name: Valley of Elah
journey.david.stop.1.note: Saul and Israel are encamped in the Valley of Elah, facing the Philistines.
journey.david.stop.2.name: Nob
journey.david.stop.2.note: Fleeing Saul, David comes to Nob, to Ahimelech the priest.
journey.david.stop.3.name: Adullam
journey.david.stop.3.note: He escapes to the cave of Adullam; his brothers and four hundred men gather to him.
journey.david.stop.4.name: En Gedi
journey.david.stop.4.note: In the cave at En-gedi David spares Saul's life.
journey.david.stop.5.name: Ziklag
journey.david.stop.5.note: Achish gives him Ziklag, which belongs to the kings of Judah to this day.
journey.david.stop.6.name: Hebron
journey.david.stop.6.note: The men of Judah anoint David king over Judah at Hebron.
journey.david.stop.7.name: Jerusalem
journey.david.stop.7.note: David takes the stronghold of Zion: the city of David.
journey.david.title: David: Shepherd to King
journey.exile.intro: The temple burns, the city is emptied, and a people learns to sing the LORD's song in a strange land. Then, decades later, the road leads home.
journey.exile.stop.0.name: Jerusalem
journey.exile.stop.0.note: Nebuzaradan burns the house of the LORD and every great house in Jerusalem.
journey.exile.stop.1.name: Riblah
journey.exile.stop.1.note: Zedekiah is brought to the king of Babylon at Riblah and judged there.
journey.exile.stop.2.name: Carchemish
journey.exile.stop.2.note: The road to Babylon passes the old battlefield of Carchemish.
journey.exile.stop.3.name: Babylon
journey.exile.stop.3.note: By the waters of Babylon, there we sat down and wept.
journey.exile.stop.4.name: Susa
journey.exile.stop.4.note: In the Persian capital the story of Esther unfolds.
journey.exile.stop.5.name: Jerusalem
journey.exile.stop.5.note: In the second year after their coming, they begin to rebuild the house of God.
journey.exile.title: Exile and Return
journey.exodus.intro: Six hundred thousand men on foot, besides women and children. A road through the sea, a mountain wrapped in fire, and forty years of desert.
journey.exodus.stop.0.name: Rameses
journey.exodus.stop.0.note: The people of Israel journey from Rameses to Succoth.
journey.exodus.stop.1.name: Etham
journey.exodus.stop.1.note: They camp at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness.
journey.exodus.stop.10.name: Ezion-geber
journey.exodus.stop.10.note: They skirt Edom southward, then turn north along the King's Highway.
journey.exodus.stop.11.name: Mount Nebo
journey.exodus.stop.11.note: Moses climbs Nebo and sees the whole land, but does not enter it.
journey.exodus.stop.2.name: Pi-hahiroth
journey.exodus.stop.2.note: Turn back and camp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea.
journey.exodus.stop.3.name: Red Sea crossing
journey.exodus.stop.3.note: The waters are a wall to the right and to the left.
journey.exodus.stop.4.name: Marah
journey.exodus.stop.4.note: Three days without water; and the water at Marah is bitter.
journey.exodus.stop.5.name: Elim
journey.exodus.stop.5.note: Twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees.
journey.exodus.stop.6.name: Rephidim
journey.exodus.stop.6.note: No water again. Moses strikes the rock at Horeb.
journey.exodus.stop.7.name: Mount Sinai
journey.exodus.stop.7.note: They camp before the mountain. Here the covenant is given, and the Law.
journey.exodus.stop.8.name: Kadesh
journey.exodus.stop.8.note: Spies return from Canaan; the people refuse to go up. Forty years of wandering follow.
journey.exodus.stop.9.name: Mount Hor
journey.exodus.sub: Out of Egypt, through the sea, to the mountain
journey.exodus.title: The Exodus
journey.jesus.intro: A birth in a small town, a ministry around a lake, and a last road up to Jerusalem.
journey.jesus.stop.0.name: Bethlehem
journey.jesus.stop.0.note: Jesus is born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king.
journey.jesus.stop.1.name: Memphis
journey.jesus.stop.1.note: The family flees by night to Egypt.
journey.jesus.stop.10.name: Golgotha
journey.jesus.stop.10.note: They came to a place called Golgotha, which means the place of a skull.
journey.jesus.stop.11.name: Emmaus
journey.jesus.stop.11.note: On the third day two travellers walk to Emmaus with a stranger.
journey.jesus.stop.2.name: Nazareth
journey.jesus.stop.2.note: They settle in a city called Nazareth.
journey.jesus.stop.3.name: Jordan
journey.jesus.stop.3.note: Jesus comes from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.
journey.jesus.stop.4.name: Cana
journey.jesus.stop.4.note: A wedding in Cana: water into wine.
journey.jesus.stop.5.name: Capernaum
journey.jesus.stop.5.note: He leaves Nazareth and makes his home in Capernaum by the sea.
journey.jesus.stop.6.name: Sychar
journey.jesus.stop.6.note: At Jacob's well in Samaria he talks with a woman at noon.
journey.jesus.stop.7.name: Bethany
journey.jesus.stop.7.note: Lazarus of Bethany is raised from the dead.
journey.jesus.stop.8.name: Jerusalem
journey.jesus.stop.8.note: He enters the city on a donkey; all the city is stirred.
journey.jesus.stop.9.name: Gethsemane
journey.jesus.stop.9.note: Then Jesus went with them to a place called Gethsemane.
journey.jesus.title: The Way of Jesus
journey.paul-1.intro: Sent out by the church at Antioch, Barnabas and Saul sail for Cyprus and then into Asia Minor.
journey.paul-1.stop.0.name: Antioch
journey.paul-1.stop.0.note: The Holy Spirit says: set apart for me Barnabas and Saul.
journey.paul-1.stop.1.name: Seleucia
journey.paul-1.stop.1.note: They go down to Seleucia and sail to Cyprus.
journey.paul-1.stop.2.name: Salamis
journey.paul-1.stop.2.note: They proclaim the word of God in the synagogues at Salamis.
journey.paul-1.stop.3.name: Paphos
journey.paul-1.stop.4.name: Perga
journey.paul-1.stop.4.note: Paul and his company sail to Perga; John Mark leaves them.
journey.paul-1.stop.5.name: Antioch of Pisidia
journey.paul-1.stop.5.note: They go into the synagogue on the Sabbath.
journey.paul-1.stop.6.name: Iconium
journey.paul-1.stop.6.note: A great number of both Jews and Greeks believe.
journey.paul-1.stop.7.name: Lystra
journey.paul-1.stop.7.note: A lame man is healed; Paul is stoned and left for dead.
journey.paul-1.stop.8.name: Derbe
journey.paul-1.stop.8.note: The next day he went on with Barnabas to Derbe.
journey.paul-1.title: Paul's First Journey
journey.paul-2.intro: A vision in the night at Troas: come over to Macedonia and help us. The gospel crosses into Europe.
journey.paul-2.stop.0.name: Antioch
journey.paul-2.stop.0.note: Paul chooses Silas and departs, commended by the brothers.
journey.paul-2.stop.1.name: Tarsus
journey.paul-2.stop.1.note: Through Syria and Cilicia he strengthens the churches.
journey.paul-2.stop.10.name: Caesarea
journey.paul-2.stop.10.note: He lands at Caesarea, goes up and greets the church.
journey.paul-2.stop.11.name: Jerusalem
journey.paul-2.stop.2.name: Lystra
journey.paul-2.stop.2.note: A disciple named Timothy joins them.
journey.paul-2.stop.3.name: Troas
journey.paul-2.stop.3.note: A vision: a man of Macedonia pleads, come over and help us.
journey.paul-2.stop.4.name: Philippi
journey.paul-2.stop.4.note: Lydia, the slave girl, the jailer: the first church in Europe.
journey.paul-2.stop.5.name: Thessalonica
journey.paul-2.stop.5.note: For three Sabbaths he reasons with them from the Scriptures.
journey.paul-2.stop.6.name: Berea
journey.paul-2.stop.6.note: The Bereans were more noble: they examined the Scriptures daily.
journey.paul-2.stop.7.name: Athens
journey.paul-2.stop.7.note: Paul stands in the midst of the Areopagus.
journey.paul-2.stop.8.name: Corinth
journey.paul-2.stop.8.note: He stays a year and a half, teaching the word of God.
journey.paul-2.stop.9.name: Ephesus
journey.paul-2.stop.9.note: They come to Ephesus and he reasons with the Jews.
journey.paul-2.title: Paul's Second Journey
journey.paul-3.intro: Three years in Ephesus, a riot in the theatre, a collection for Jerusalem, and tearful goodbyes on the beach at Miletus.
journey.paul-3.stop.0.name: Ephesus
journey.paul-3.stop.0.note: All who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord, Jews and Greeks.
journey.paul-3.stop.1.name: Philippi
journey.paul-3.stop.1.note: After the uproar Paul departs for Macedonia.
journey.paul-3.stop.2.name: Corinth
journey.paul-3.stop.2.note: He came to Greece and spent three months there.
journey.paul-3.stop.3.name: Troas
journey.paul-3.stop.3.note: Eutychus falls asleep during a long sermon, and is raised.
journey.paul-3.stop.4.name: Miletus
journey.paul-3.stop.4.note: He sends for the elders of Ephesus: you will not see my face again.
journey.paul-3.stop.5.name: Tyre
journey.paul-3.stop.5.note: They sail to Syria and land at Tyre.
journey.paul-3.stop.6.name: Caesarea
journey.paul-3.stop.6.note: At the house of Philip the evangelist, a prophet warns of chains.
journey.paul-3.stop.7.name: Jerusalem
journey.paul-3.stop.7.note: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.
journey.paul-3.title: Paul's Third Journey
journey.paul-rome.intro: A prisoner appeals to Caesar. Fourteen days of storm; every soul reaches shore.
journey.paul-rome.stop.0.name: Caesarea
journey.paul-rome.stop.0.note: Paul and some other prisoners are put in the charge of the centurion Julius.
journey.paul-rome.stop.1.name: Sidon
journey.paul-rome.stop.1.note: The next day we put in at Sidon.
journey.paul-rome.stop.2.name: Fair Havens, Crete
journey.paul-rome.stop.2.note: With difficulty we came to a place called Fair Havens.
journey.paul-rome.stop.3.name: Storm at sea
journey.paul-rome.stop.3.note: A tempestuous wind called the northeaster struck down from the land.
journey.paul-rome.stop.4.name: Malta
journey.paul-rome.stop.4.note: After we were brought safely through, we then learned that the island was called Malta.
journey.paul-rome.stop.5.name: Syracuse
journey.paul-rome.stop.5.note: Putting in at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.
journey.paul-rome.stop.6.name: Puteoli
journey.paul-rome.stop.6.note: We came to Puteoli, where we found brothers.
journey.paul-rome.stop.7.name: Rome
journey.paul-rome.stop.7.note: And when we came into Rome, Paul was allowed to stay by himself.
journey.paul-rome.title: Paul's Voyage to Rome

journey.person.sub: Places mentioned alongside {name}, in order of the text
journey.revelation.intro: John, exiled on a small island, writes seven letters to seven cities arranged along a Roman postal road.
journey.revelation.stop.0.name: Patmos
journey.revelation.stop.0.note: I was on the island called Patmos on account of the word of God.
journey.revelation.stop.1.name: Ephesus
journey.revelation.stop.1.note: You have abandoned the love you had at first.
journey.revelation.stop.2.name: Smyrna
journey.revelation.stop.2.note: Be faithful unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
journey.revelation.stop.3.name: Pergamum
journey.revelation.stop.3.note: I know where you dwell, where Satan's throne is.
journey.revelation.stop.4.name: Thyatira
journey.revelation.stop.4.note: Your latter works exceed the first.
journey.revelation.stop.5.name: Sardis
journey.revelation.stop.5.note: You have the reputation of being alive, but you are dead.
journey.revelation.stop.6.name: Philadelphia
journey.revelation.stop.6.note: I have set before you an open door that no one can shut.
journey.revelation.stop.7.name: Laodicea
journey.revelation.stop.7.note: Because you are lukewarm, I will spit you out of my mouth.
journey.revelation.title: The Seven Churches
